summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.

Goal for this session: add OpenTelemetry tracing spans around the invoice sync worker.

Operator: please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Operator: Forget the tracing work for now. The tax calculation for Canadian provinces in ledgerly/tax/ca.py is wrong for Quebec (QST); fix that first.

Separate procedure `terraform-vpc-peering`: run its nine specified steps in order, one at a time, between other work.

Operator: Correction on buckets: staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Recent work
Search rebuilds now use tenant-scoped scans, concurrent embedding in chunks of 100, shared embedding clients, and transactional bulk upserts. A tenant/document unique-index migration was added. Full tests passed (247 passed, 4 skipped); benchmark median was 2.41s for 10,000 documents versus 16.73s previously. Terraform step 6 created pending-acceptance peering connection `pcx-0a9b8c7d6e5f40312`; continue step 7. CSV export encoding failure remains reproduced. Quebec QST fix is still pending.
